column3: With respect to the 512 West 22nd Street Mortgage Loan (9.4%), 162,834 square feet (approximately 94.4% of the net rentable square footage) is used for office space and 9,742 square feet (5.6% of the net rentable square footage) is used for retail space. Kenneth Cole Productions, Inc., the third largest tenant (approximately 11.9% of the net rentable square footage), occupies 18,700 square feet of office space and 1,759 square feet of retail space.
